T: Five strangers. One detention. Plenty of snacks.
D: Five very different students spend a Saturday detention together.
P: Serve the snacks when everyone unpacks their lunch.
S: Salmon and avocado maki with salmon nigiri, soy, wasabi and pickled ginger, packed neatly into a bento box like it's Saturday detention at Shermer High. Rinse 400g sushi rice, cook with 480ml water, then fold through 80ml rice vinegar mixed with 1 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt and cool. Lay rice over 3 nori sheets, add strips of salmon and avocado, roll tight with a mat and cut each into 8. Shape 8 small rice oblongs, dab with wasabi and top with sliced sashimi salmon. Pack into 4 bento boxes with soy, wasabi and pickled ginger.
the wrestler's lunch, three sandwiches deep

Toasted triple-decker of leg ham, Swiss and cheddar with mustard mayo and pickles, cut into fingers, with crunchy apple slices on the side. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard. Toast 12 slices white bread. Build 4 stacks of toast, sauce, 50g leg ham and a slice of Swiss, toast, sauce, 50g leg ham, a slice of cheddar and pickles, then toast. Press lightly, cut each into 3 fingers and pin with toothpicks. Slice 2 apples and toss with lemon juice to serve alongside.
he has no lunch, so share yours
A plate of crackers, cheese and salami left in the middle for anyone who forgot.
M: soup in a thermos, PB and J with the crusts cut off
Tomato soup (roasted tomatoes, onion, garlic and stock blitzed with cream) in a thermos, peanut butter and jam sandwiches with the crusts cut off.
her sugar and cereal sandwich, if you dare

Thick brioche dipped in vanilla custard, crusted in crushed sweet cereal and fried golden in butter, with whipped cream, berries and maple syrup. Whisk 4 eggs, 250ml milk, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of cinnamon. Crush 120g sweet corn cereal into coarse crumbs. Dip 8 thick slices brioche in the custard for 20 seconds a side, then press both sides into the cereal. Fry in 40g butter over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden and crunchy. Serve with whipped cream, berries and maple syrup.
W: Melted dark chocolate and butter whisked into sugar and eggs, flour folded in, baked at 175C for 25 minutes, pulled while the middle still wobbles.
K: Andrew's carton of milk, upgraded for Saturday detention

Fresh strawberries blended with vanilla ice cream and cold milk until thick and pink, topped with whipped cream and a fresh strawberry. Hull 250g strawberries, keeping 4 for garnish. Blend the rest with 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 500ml cold milk and 1 tbsp caster sugar for 30 seconds until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall glasses, top with whipped cream and a strawberry on the rim, and serve with straws.

s.note: Crackers, cheese and salami for anyone who forgot their lunch.
s.how: Arrange 80g crackers, 100g cubed cheddar and 80g sliced salami on a shared plate in the middle of the table. Let everyone help themselves.

m.note: Roasted tomato soup with cream, plus crustless peanut butter and jam sandwiches.
m.how: Halve 800g tomatoes and put in a roasting dish with 1 quartered brown onion, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tbsp olive oil. Roast at 200°C conventional for 35 minutes until softened and browned. Transfer to a pot with 500ml chicken stock and simmer 10 minutes. Blitz smooth with 80ml thickened cream and season with salt and pepper. Pour into four warmed thermoses. Make four peanut butter and jam sandwiches with 8 slices white bread, 80g peanut butter and 60g jam; cut off the crusts and serve with the soup.

w.note: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies with a soft centre and crisp edges.
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100g butter gently and cool slightly. Whisk in 120g caster sugar and 2 eggs. Fold in 60g plain flour and a pinch of salt. Pour into a lined 18cm square tin and bake at 175°C conventional for 25 minutes until the edges are set and the middle still gently wobbles. Cool at least 30 minutes before cutting into four portions.
